meta.parties: Application of S. E. Fernando For A Mandamus On the Rubber Controller

rules.statement: A mandamus is not granted to review the exercise of a discretion or an erroneous judgment. The decision of the proper officer on a matter within his jurisdiction cannot be called in question by mandamus.
rules.supporting_quote: "The decision however erroneous of the proper officer-a tribunal on a matter within its jurisdiction cannot be called in question by mandamus."
